ADJUST SILENCE DETECTION

For recordings lasting hours. Use Chrome or Edge on desktop over HTTPS (GitHub Pages). Choose the output location before processing. Keep this tab open. Your audio is never uploaded. Output uses RF64 WAV if it exceeds 4 GiB; those files may require VLC or an audio editor.

Choose a file to get started.

Volume-based detection, designed for speech. Loud background noise may remain; very quiet speech may be cut. Preview the result before keeping it. Short-file mode loads the recording into memory; use long recording mode for large files. Processing speed depends on your device and the audio format.
